blurb: Guests take guided cruises on the Saint Lawrence River with views of Montreal and its islands. Options include 60-minute and 90-minute guided tours with bilingual guides and a dinner cruise with a customizable à la carte menu. The boat features panoramic windows, an open roof terrace (weather permitting), and a bar with snacks for purchase.
